question:

solution:
The logic followed here is:

And, The symbol 'plus' is rotating in an anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac74e72ce81fa74bb57a11b5c27c9f292ba14d0c17d0a3d92709cb53ec969917.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
